_comment: Houdini RFSoC single-UE client. Runs the unmodified receiver.cc client-sync path (clientSyncTxRx -> syncSearch -> find_beacon) on the Houdini radio via the ClientRadioSet houdini backend. Beacon is transmitted separately by beacon_tx_gold from the BS board. Matched-NCO Zone-1 loopback: TX ch1 -> RX ch1, NCO 500 MHz. slot=4096 samps -> detect window ~9544 > beacon. 30 slots x 4096 = 122880 samps = EXACTLY 1 ms per frame so the UE pilot TX time quantizes onto Houdini's whole-ms TX grid at a constant advance.
_ue_tdd_pilot_note: UE streams its pilot with the tdd=1 TX stream arg -> the driver TxTickAnchor accepts the beacon-referenced start on the 3.125us TDD window grid (SH-248/SH-301), not whole-ms, so no 1ms drift-cliff. ue_tx_advance_ticks (ticks) is the fine calibration that seats the pilot in the BS rx_gate; sweep it.
_bs_hw_framer_note: true selects the BS native-Houdini-TDD framer path: beacon replay strobe + one rx_gate window per sounder pilot slot; loopRecv's HW-framer true-path receives only those, tagged with the sounder slot. The TDD symbol is a fixed 0.5ms (decoupled from the slot) so the capture fits inside the rx_gate window; samps_per_slot just needs to be <= 4096 (FPGA TX_RAM, else genPilots' size_t remain_size underflows). 48*80 + 128+128 = 4096.
